# inject: KeyValueExpr key name not counted as usage for parameter naming
inject G f
-- x.go --
package p

var G int

type S struct{ g int }

func f() { h() }
func h() { _ = S{g: G} }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@

 type S struct{ g int }

-func f() { h() }
-func h() { _ = S{g: G} }
+func f()      { h(G) }
+func h(g int) { _ = S{g: g} }
